title: Security Deposit Account Programs: Entry Criteria and Required Deposit Schedule
content:
Every Security Deposit Account is written on one of six deposit programs. Each program has entry criteria drawn from the lease's screening record and a basis on which its required cash deposit is set. This schedule gives both for every program. It is ranked from the lowest-deposit program (rank 1) to the highest (rank 6).

## Entry criteria

| Rank | Program | Screening result | Credit score | Other criteria |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan | approved | 650 or higher | The resident elects the guarantee; not available on the Penthouse Residence floor plan |
| 2 | Reduced Deposit Plan | approved | 720 or higher | none |
| 3 | Standard Deposit Plan | approved | no minimum | none |
| 4 | Premier Residence Deposit Plan | approved | no minimum | Penthouse Residence floor plan |
| 5 | Conditional Approval Deposit Plan | approved with conditions | 600 or higher | none |
| 6 | Enhanced Deposit Plan | approved with conditions | 599 or lower | none |

## Required cash deposit basis

| Program | Basis | Flat amount (USD) | Multiple of monthly rent | Minimum on a rent-multiple basis (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan | guarantee (no cash deposit) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Reduced Deposit Plan | flat | 200.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Standard Deposit Plan | flat | 500.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Premier Residence Deposit Plan | flat | 1500.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Conditional Approval Deposit Plan | multiple of monthly rent | 0.00 | 1.00 | 750.00 |
| Enhanced Deposit Plan | multiple of monthly rent | 0.00 | 1.50 | 1000.00 |

**Reading the basis.** On a flat basis the required deposit is the flat amount shown. On a rent-multiple basis it is the multiple shown times the lease's monthly rent, never less than the minimum shown. On the guarantee basis there is no cash deposit.

### Illustrations (hypothetical rents)

- Conditional Approval Deposit Plan, hypothetical monthly rent 1800.00 USD: 1.00 times 1800.00 is 1800.00, which is above the 750.00 minimum, so the table gives 1800.00 USD.
- Enhanced Deposit Plan, hypothetical monthly rent 600.00 USD: 1.50 times 600.00 is 900.00, which is below the 1000.00 minimum, so the table gives 1000.00 USD.
- Standard Deposit Plan: 500.00 USD whatever the rent.
